metadata.name: Midnight Lite
metadata.description:
Midnight Lite is a free, dark landing page template for AI and SaaS products, under the MIT license.

Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, TypeScript. One page: a header, a hero with a night sky and an engraved guilloche rosette, product tiles with cited sources, a closing call to action and a footer, laid out separately for phones. Every word sits in one file, and AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md tell your AI editor how the page is built.

The theme and sections also install one by one with npx shadcn add from the @vilqor registry: midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/registry.json

Code: github.com/vilqor/midnight-lite

The full Midnight adds seven more sections, working forms, analytics and a second language: templates.vilqor.com/midnight

metadata.name: Cerio Labs
metadata.description:
Premium AI SaaS & B2B Next.js Website Template.

A sophisticated website template for the next generation of AI-powered businesses.

PREVIEW👉

Cerio Labs is a modern, beautifully crafted Next.js website template designed for AI startups, SaaS platforms, B2B software companies, and innovative technology brands.



Combining elegant editorial typography, a refined visual identity, immersive geometric backgrounds, and thoughtfully designed interactions, Cerio Labs helps ambitious software companies establish a distinctive digital presence.



Built with a focus on aesthetics, performance, and flexibility, Cerio Labs provides a polished starting point for launching your next AI product, showcasing your technology, or building a compelling software marketing website.



Highlights

Premium Visual Design — Elegant typography, sophisticated layouts, and a refined forest-green color palette.

Next.js & Modern Frontend — Built using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Immersive Visual Effects — A distinctive geometric network background with a futuristic, technology-inspired aesthetic.

Conversion-Focused Layouts — Clear messaging, prominent calls to action, and thoughtfully structured content.

Customizable Design System — Reusable UI components and design tokens for effortless brand customization.

Static-Ready Architecture — Designed for fast, efficient static website deployment.



Perfect For

AI startups, SaaS products, B2B software companies, automation platforms, technology startups, and digital product businesses.
